extensionDescription.message: Send links and discover page media for review in ChopChop.

pairInstructions.message: In ChopChop → Settings → Browser Capture, enable integration and copy the pairing code.

paired.message: Paired. Keep ChopChop open when sending links.

popupInstructions.message: Select media found in this page, or send the current link. ChopChop will ask you to review it.

invalidPairing.message: Copy the pairing code from ChopChop → Settings → Browser Capture.

noLinks.message: No supported download links were selected.

unavailable.message: Cannot connect to ChopChop. Open the app; if it is already running, enable receiving in Settings → Browser Capture, then try again.

pairingRejected.message: Pairing was rejected. Copy a new pairing code from ChopChop.

rateLimited.message: Please wait a moment before sending more links.

rejected.message: ChopChop could not accept these links. Review the selection and try a smaller batch.

noMedia.message: No direct media found. You can send this page link, or copy the direct download URL.

pageRestricted.message: This page cannot be inspected. Right-click a download link instead.

uncertain.message: The submission result is unknown. Refresh recent submissions and check ChopChop before sending again.

receiptMissing.message: No receipt exists for this request. You can send the selection again.

contextIncluded.message: Request details included for this selection only. Review them in ChopChop.

contextUnavailable.message: Select one HTTP or HTTPS link to include request details.

receipt_partial.message: Some downloads created; remaining items cancelled

cookiesForgotten.message: Optional cookie and site access removed.

receiptCapacity.message: Too many unresolved submissions. Refresh their status and review ChopChop before sending more.

appUpdateRequired.message: Update and restart ChopChop before using this extension. No download was submitted to the older app.
